issues.title: Missing Acceptance Criteria for ORM and View Rules
issues.why: While naming and schema design have ACs (AC-03, AC-09), the mandatory 'ORM-First' and 'No On-the-fly Joins' rules in 03-orm-and-views.md lack GWT criteria and verification clauses.
issues.fix: Add AC-10 and AC-11 to 97-acceptance-criteria.md specifically covering ORM usage and View-based joins with grep-based verification commands.

issues.title: Incomplete Concurrency Handling in SQLite
issues.why: The spec acknowledges SQLite is single-writer but offloads the actual locking/retry logic (WAL, BEGIN IMMEDIATE) to a cross-reference (spec/13) which is not provided in this context.
issues.fix: Inline the mandatory SQLite PRAGMAs and transaction retry policy into 02-schema-design.md §4.3.

issues.title: Dangling Reference to Split-DB Pattern
issues.why: 02-schema-design.md §4.1 and 00-overview.md point to 07-split-db-pattern.md for 'full specification', but that file's content is missing from the provided context.
issues.fix: Provide the content for 07-split-db-pattern.md or merge its core directory layout rules into the overview.
